routes.title: Donate, Volunteer & Advocate | TechSmart
routes.mainText:
I Want to Help

Your support helps TechSmart provide technology education and resources for older adults.

Making an Impact Together

Since 2012, TechSmart Learning for Seniors has educated more than 7,000 older adults across metro Atlanta.

Through technology education, volunteers, donations, and community partnerships, TechSmart helps older adults build digital skills, gain confidence, and stay connected.

7,000+

Older adults educated since 2012

Technology Education

Helping older adults learn everyday digital skills.

Stronger Communities

Supporting confidence, independence, and connection through technology.

AI-generated illustrations of senior technology learning.
How Would You Like to Help?

Donate, volunteer your time, or learn how you can advocate for technology education.

Donate

Support technology education and learning opportunities for older adults.

Donate
Volunteer

Share your time and skills by helping older adults become more confident with technology.

Register with Hands on Atlanta
Advocate

Learn about TechSmart's community impact and help spread awareness about technology education for older adults.

Learn About Our Impact
Our Community Partners & Supporters

TechSmart Learning for Seniors is grateful for the organizations and individuals who support technology education for older adults.

Through financial contributions, volunteer time, and community resources, our supporters help older adults build digital skills, confidence, and meaningful connections.

$5,000 and Above

$5,000 and Above
